formula.fn.LEFT: The first characters of the text.
formula.fn.RIGHT: The last characters of the text.
formula.fn.MID: Characters from the middle of the text.
formula.fn.LEN: Length of the text, counted in Unicode code points.
formula.fn.TRIM: Removes surrounding spaces and collapses repeated spaces.
formula.fn.CONCAT: Joins text from values and ranges, row by row.
formula.fn.TEXTJOIN: Joins text with a delimiter, optionally skipping blanks.
formula.fn.SUBSTITUTE: Replaces occurrences of one piece of text with another.
formula.fn.REPLACE: Replaces a fixed run of characters with new text.

formula.fn.UPPER: Converts the text to upper case.
formula.fn.LOWER: Converts the text to lower case.
formula.fn.TODAY: Today's date in the file's timezone (UTC unless set) as a date serial; updates when recalculated.
formula.fn.NOW: The current date and time in the file's timezone (UTC unless set) as a serial; updates when recalculated.

formula.fn.MEDIAN: The middle value of the numbers.

dialog.formulaHelp.title: Formula and Function Help
dialog.formulaHelp.intro: Formulas start with =. Search by function name or topic.
dialog.formulaHelp.noResults: No help entries match your search.
dialog.formulaHelp.syntaxBody: A formula starts with = followed by an expression, for example =A1+B1*2. Text values use double quotes ("like this"). Whitespace is ignored. Formulas work in RSF files; entering one in a CSV file asks whether to convert it to an RSF spreadsheet.
dialog.formulaHelp.referencesBody: Refer to a cell by its column letters and 1-based row number. A1 is relative: copying or filling the formula shifts it by the same offset. A $ marker fixes a component when the formula is copied or filled: $A$1 is fully absolute (never shifts), $A1 fixes only the column, and A$1 fixes only the row. For example, filling =A1*$B$1 down one row gives =A2*$B$1. Inserting or deleting rows/columns adjusts absolute and relative references alike, keeping every reference pointing at the same data. $ markers also work as range endpoints, e.g. SUM($A$1:$A10).
dialog.formulaHelp.rangesBody: A rectangular range is two corner references joined by a colon (A1:B10). A:A or A:C covers whole columns; 1:1 or 2:10 covers whole rows. Whole-column and whole-row ranges stop at the sheet's last row or column.
dialog.formulaHelp.operatorsBody: Arithmetic: + - * / with parentheses for grouping. Comparisons = <> < > <= >= return TRUE or FALSE, useful as the condition in IF.
dialog.formulaHelp.errorsIntro: When a formula cannot be evaluated it shows an error code as its value:
dialog.formulaHelp.err.error: The formula is not valid (a syntax error).
dialog.formulaHelp.err.name: The formula uses a function or name that does not exist.
dialog.formulaHelp.err.value: A value has the wrong type (for example adding text), or a range was used where a single value is required.
dialog.formulaHelp.err.div0: Division by zero (including AVERAGE of no numbers).
dialog.formulaHelp.err.ref: A reference points to a cell that was deleted, or the reference is not valid.
dialog.formulaHelp.err.cycle: A circular reference: a formula depends on its own result, directly or indirectly.
dialog.formulaHelp.section.autocomplete: Function suggestions and mouse range entry
dialog.formulaHelp.autocompleteBody: While typing a function name a suggestion list appears; press Tab or Enter to accept, or Esc to dismiss. While editing a formula, click a cell to insert its reference, or drag across cells to insert a range.
dialog.formulaHelp.err.na: A lookup found no match. XLOOKUP can return a value of your choice instead.
dialog.formulaHelp.err.num: A number is out of range, or a calculation produced no finite result.
dialog.formulaHelp.err.spill: A dynamic array cannot write its result: something is in the way, or it would run past the last row or column.
dialog.formulaHelp.err.calc: A dynamic array produced no values at all, for example FILTER with nothing matching.
dialog.formulaHelp.criteriaBody: A criterion is a value, or text starting with a comparison operator. Text matches case-insensitively. * matches any run of characters and ? matches exactly one; write ~* , ~? , or ~~ for a literal one. An ordering comparison such as ">10" only matches numbers, and "<>x" only matches text; "" matches blank cells and "<>" matches non-blank ones. Every criteria range must have the same shape, otherwise the result is #VALUE!.
dialog.formulaHelp.lookupsBody: XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, and MATCH return #N/A when nothing matches; XLOOKUP's fourth argument replaces that with a value of your choice. XLOOKUP supports exact matching (match_mode 0) and wildcard matching (2), searching forwards (search_mode 1) or backwards (-1); the approximate and binary-search modes are not implemented and report #VALUE! rather than quietly searching a different way. VLOOKUP and MATCH do offer approximate matching, which assumes the lookup column is sorted ascending — with unsorted data the answer is defined but not meaningful.
dialog.formulaHelp.datesBody: A date is a number: serial 0 is 1899-12-30, whole numbers are days, and the fractional part is the time of day. Date arithmetic uses UTC, so a file computes the same values on every device. DATE rolls month and day overflow into neighbouring months and years, so DATE(2020, 3, 0) is the last day of February. Dates display as their serial number; use YEAR, MONTH, and DAY to read the parts. TODAY and NOW use the file's timezone (set in Sheet > Timezone…, UTC unless set) and update when the file is edited or when you choose Recalculate, never just because time passes.
dialog.formulaHelp.textBody: LEN, LEFT, RIGHT, MID, and REPLACE count Unicode code points, so Japanese characters and emoji are never cut in half. A combining accent and a multi-person emoji each count as more than one, because the alternative would make results depend on the host's Unicode tables. TRIM removes surrounding whitespace and collapses runs of ordinary spaces, but never touches line breaks or ideographic spaces. Text results are capped at 32,767 characters.
dialog.formulaHelp.arraysBody: FILTER, UNIQUE, SORT, and SEQUENCE return a whole rectangle of values. The formula stays in one cell — the spill anchor — and the rest of the rectangle is filled in automatically. Those filled cells are not editable: edit or clear the anchor instead. If anything is in the way, or the rectangle would run past the last row or column, the anchor shows #SPILL! and writes nothing at all. Only the anchor's formula is saved; the spilled values are recomputed each time the file is opened. Arithmetic does not spread over an array: =SEQUENCE(3)+1 is #VALUE!, not three numbers.
dialog.formulaHelp.section.filterVsFilte: FILTER() is not the Filter command
dialog.formulaHelp.filterVsFilterBody: The FILTER function computes a new list of matching rows into empty cells, leaving the source untouched. Sheet > Filter & Sort > Filter… hides non-matching rows of the sheet you are looking at, changes no values, and is saved with the file. They are independent: filtering a sheet does not change what FILTER returns.

dialog.about.title: About Refrain Sheet
dialog.about.tagline: A local-first, format-preserving CSV and spreadsheet editor.
dialog.about.body: Refrain Sheet edits CSV cell values and keeps everything else byte-for-byte where possible: delimiters, quoting, whitespace, line endings, encodings, BOMs, unreadable characters, and malformed parts. Spreadsheet features such as formulas and inserting rows and columns are available in RSF (Refrain Sheet Format) files. It runs fully offline; no data ever leaves this page.
dialog.about.bodyHosted: Refrain Sheet edits CSV cell values and keeps everything else byte-for-byte where possible: delimiters, quoting, whitespace, line endings, encodings, BOMs, unreadable characters, and malformed parts. Spreadsheet features such as formulas and inserting rows and columns are available in RSF (Refrain Sheet Format) files. Files are opened and saved on your device; only when you use Google Drive sync are the files you choose to sync uploaded.
dialog.shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
dialog.shortcuts.note: Every shortcut command is also on the menus. Ctrl+F, Ctrl+H, F3, Ctrl+G, and Ctrl+E act in this app rather than the browser (the browser's own find stays in its menu). Keys the browser needs (Ctrl+N/T/W, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown, reload, print, zoom, dev tools) keep working in the browser.
dialog.shortcuts.appearanceNote: Spreadsheet zoom scales only the sheet area and does not affect browser zoom. To type with an IME (Japanese, Chinese, Korean), select a cell and start typing.

dialog.convert.title: Convert to RSF Spreadsheet?
dialog.convert.formula: To use formulas, "{name}" must be converted to an RSF spreadsheet; a CSV file cannot store them. If you cancel, what you typed stays as plain text.
dialog.convert.paste: The pasted data does not fit in the existing rows and columns of "{name}". To add rows or columns, convert it to an RSF spreadsheet first.
dialog.convert.structure: To insert or delete rows or columns, convert "{name}" to an RSF spreadsheet first. A CSV file's row and column structure is never changed.
dialog.convert.fill: To fill values or formulas across cells, convert "{name}" to an RSF spreadsheet first.
dialog.convert.command: Converts "{name}" to an RSF spreadsheet, which supports formulas, inserting and deleting rows and columns, fill, saved column widths, and more. The current content, including unsaved changes, is converted.
dialog.convert.filter: To use filters, convert "{name}" to an RSF spreadsheet first.
dialog.convert.sort: To sort, convert "{name}" to an RSF spreadsheet first.
dialog.convert.validation: To use data validation, convert "{name}" to an RSF spreadsheet first.
dialog.convert.conditionalFormat: To use conditional formatting, convert "{name}" to an RSF spreadsheet first.
dialog.convert.comment: To add cell comments, convert "{name}" to an RSF spreadsheet first.
dialog.convert.move: To move cells, convert "{name}" to an RSF spreadsheet first.
dialog.convert.note: After conversion this tab becomes an RSF spreadsheet, and saving creates an .rsf file. The original CSV file is not changed. This tab's undo history is cleared.
dialog.convert.commandNote: The spreadsheet opens in a new tab, and saving creates an .rsf file. The original CSV tab and file are not changed.
dialog.rsfSave.title: Save as RSF
dialog.rsfSave.message: "{name}" has content a CSV file cannot store, such as formulas or row and column edits, so it is saved in the .rsf format.
dialog.rsfSave.note: To save the calculated values as a plain CSV file, use File > Export > Export as CSV….
dialog.rsfSave.help: .rsf is a documented JSON format compressed with Zstandard.
dialog.exportCsv.title: Export as CSV
dialog.exportCsv.warning: Formulas are written as their calculated values, and formatting, column widths, and similar settings are left out. The open file is not changed.
dialog.exportCsv.notPreserved: Not included in the CSV: formulas, rows and columns outside the exported area, column widths, formatting, font settings, and other spreadsheet-only information.
dialog.exportCsv.bomNote: A BOM applies only to UTF-8.
dialog.exportXlsx.title: Export as XLSX
dialog.exportXlsx.message: Exports "{name}" as an .xlsx file, including every sheet.
dialog.exportXlsx.warning: Formulas are written as their calculated values, and formatting, column widths, and similar settings are left out. The open file is not changed.
dialog.exportXlsx.notPreserved: Not included in the .xlsx: formulas, cell formatting and number formats, column widths, filters, and other spreadsheet-only information.
dialog.exportJson.title: Export as JSON
dialog.exportJson.message: Exports "{name}" as a .json file: an array with one object per row, using the first row as field names.
dialog.exportJson.warning: Formulas are written as their calculated values, and only the current sheet is written. The open file is not changed.
dialog.exportJson.notPreserved: Not included in the .json: formulas, cell formatting and number formats, column widths, filters, other sheets, and other spreadsheet-only information.
dialog.insertCells.title: Insert Copied Cells
dialog.insertCells.message: Inserts the copied {rows} × {cols} cells at the selection. Existing cells shift right or down.
dialog.insertCells.note: Shifting cells down inserts whole rows across the sheet; shifting right inserts whole columns. Existing references adjust exactly like Insert Rows/Columns, and relative references in the inserted formulas shift by their offset from the copied location. Ctrl+Z undoes the whole insertion.
dialog.deleteRows.title: Delete Rows
dialog.deleteRows.message: Delete {n} row(s)? Any values in them are deleted too. You can undo this with Ctrl+Z.
dialog.deleteCols.title: Delete Columns
dialog.deleteCols.message: Delete {n} column(s)? Any values in them are deleted too. You can undo this with Ctrl+Z.
dialog.rsfInvalid.title: Cannot Open RSF File
dialog.rsfInvalid.message: "{name}" could not be opened as an RSF file: {reason}
dialog.rsfInvalid.badMagic: the file is not a Refrain Sheet file.
dialog.rsfInvalid.legacyFormat: it uses the older binary .rsf/.rcsv format, which this release no longer opens. Open it in version 0.8.x and export it as CSV or XLSX, then open that file here.
dialog.rsfInvalid.badVersion: the file was saved by a newer version of Refrain Sheet. Open it with the latest version.
dialog.rsfInvalid.badShape: the file's structure is not valid.
dialog.rsfInvalid.compression: reading this compressed file needs the WebAssembly engine, which is unavailable in this environment.
dialog.rsfInvalid.tooLarge: the sheet exceeds the supported size limits.
dialog.xlsxInvalid.title: Cannot Open XLSX File
dialog.xlsxInvalid.message: "{name}" could not be opened as an XLSX file: {reason}
dialog.xlsxInvalid.notAZip: the file cannot be read as XLSX (it is not a ZIP archive).
dialog.xlsxInvalid.missingWorkbook: the file is missing its workbook structure.
dialog.xlsxInvalid.noSheets: the file does not contain any sheets.
dialog.xlsxInvalid.corruptEntry: the file is corrupt or uses an unsupported feature.
dialog.xlsxInvalid.tooLarge: the file exceeds the supported size limits.
dialog.jsonInvalid.title: Cannot Open JSON File
dialog.jsonInvalid.message: "{name}" could not be opened as a table: {reason}
dialog.jsonInvalid.invalidJson: the file is not valid JSON.
dialog.jsonInvalid.notAnArray: only a top-level JSON array of objects is supported (one element per row).
dialog.jsonInvalid.emptyArray: the array is empty, so there are no columns to import.
dialog.jsonInvalid.notFlatObject: every array element must be a flat object; nested objects and arrays as values are not supported.
notify.converted: Converted to an RSF spreadsheet. Saving creates an .rsf file; the original CSV file is unchanged.
notify.convertedNewTab: Opened "{name}" as an RSF spreadsheet in a new tab. The original CSV tab is unchanged.
notify.xlsxImported: Imported the calculated values as "{name}". Saving creates a new .rsf file; the original .xlsx file is unchanged.
notify.jsonImported: Imported the array of objects as "{name}". Saving creates a new .rsf file; the original .json file is unchanged.
notify.copied: Copied the selected range to the clipboard.
notify.cut: Cut the selected range to the clipboard.
notify.cutBlocked: The browser did not allow clipboard access, so nothing was cut. Use Ctrl+X instead.
notify.copiedScreenshot: Copied the selected range to the clipboard as an image, matching its on-screen appearance.
notify.copiedMarkdown: Copied the selected range to the clipboard as a Markdown table.
notify.copyImageUnsupported: Copying as an image isn't supported in this browser or context.
notify.clipboardBlocked: The browser did not allow clipboard access here. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V still work.
notify.pasteBlocked: The browser did not allow reading the clipboard here. Use Ctrl+V / Cmd+V instead.
notify.cannotDeleteAll: The last remaining rows or columns cannot be deleted.
notify.exportedCsvDownload: Started downloading the calculated values as "{name}".
notify.exportedXlsxDownload: Started downloading the calculated values as "{name}".
notify.exportedJsonDownload: Started downloading the calculated values as "{name}".
notify.nothingToInsert: Nothing to insert: copy a cell range first.
notify.insertedCols: Inserted {n} copied column(s) to the left of column {col}.
notify.selectAllEmpty: There are no cells to select in this file.
notify.tabMoved: Moved the tab for "{name}" to position {pos} of {total}.
notify.noExportableSheet: This file has no sheet that can be exported as CSV. Markdown, JSON, YAML, and text sheets cannot be exported as CSV.
notify.wrapEnabled: Turned on Wrap Long Cell Text because the cell contains a line break.
dialog.replaceWorkbook.title: Replace across the entire file?
dialog.replaceWorkbook.message: This will make {matches} replacements in {cells} cells across {sheets} of {total} sheets.
dialog.replaceWorkbook.scope: Sheets you are not currently viewing will be changed. Formula expressions are replaced as written; calculated values are never overwritten directly.
move.csvOnly: Cells cannot be moved in a CSV file. Convert it first with File > This File > Convert to RSF Spreadsheet….
move.outOfBounds: The cells cannot be moved there: the destination would fall outside the sheet.
move.error.invalid: Enter a cell reference such as C4.
move.error.outOfBounds: The whole range must fit inside the sheet (up to {cols}{rows}).
move.error.sameplace: That is where the cells already are.
grid.moveHandleTitle: Drag here or the selection border to move the selected cells (RSF only)
dialog.moveRange.title: Move Selected Cells
dialog.moveRange.message: Move {source} to a new location on this sheet.
dialog.moveRange.label: Destination (top-left cell)
dialog.moveRange.hint: Formulas that referred to the moved cells are updated to follow them, across every sheet.
dialog.moveRange.overwriteMessage: The destination {target} already contains data: {n} cells would be replaced.
goToCell.error.invalid: Enter a cell reference such as C4.
goToCell.error.outOfBounds: That reference is outside the sheet (up to {cols}{rows}).
dialog.goToCell.title: Go to Cell
dialog.goToCell.label: Cell reference
notify.sheetLimit: A file can hold at most {max} sheets.
notify.cannotDeleteLastSheet: A file must keep at least one sheet.
dialog.sqlQuery.title: SQL Query
dialog.sqlQuery.intro: Runs an SQL SELECT query on one sheet or the open CSV. The source data is not changed.
dialog.sqlQuery.help.body: A single read-only SELECT statement, run by an embedded SQLite engine — WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT, joins, subqueries, CASE, and SQLite's usual functions are all available. The picked data source is always named "data". INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and other statements that could change data are not allowed.
dialog.sqlQuery.status.truncated: Showing {shown} of {matched} matching row(s). Add LIMIT or narrow the query to see the rest.
dialog.sqlQuery.status.sourceTruncated: Only the first {cap} rows of the data source were read; rows after that may be missing from the result.
dialog.sqlQuery.suggestions.label: Suggestions
dialog.sqlQuery.history.title: Query history
dialog.sqlQuery.saved.title: Saved queries
dialog.sqlQuery.saved.nameRequired: Enter a name to save this query.
dialog.sqlQuery.saved.limitReached: Saved-query limit reached ({max}); delete one to save another.
sql.error.tooLong: The query is longer than the {max}-character limit.
sql.error.tooManyTokens: The query has more than {max} tokens.
sql.error.unterminatedString: The query has an unterminated string literal (a missing closing quote).
sql.error.unterminatedIdentifier: The query has an unterminated quoted identifier (a missing closing quote).
sql.error.unsupportedStatement: Only a single, read-only SELECT query is supported.
sql.error.multipleStatements: Only one SELECT statement is allowed.
sql.error.engineUnavailable: The SQL engine is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
dialog.diff.title: Compare / Diff
dialog.diff.intro: Compares the current tab with another open tab, matching rows by key columns. Neither is changed.
dialog.diff.status.counts: {added} added, {modified} modified, {deleted} deleted, {unchanged} unchanged, {keyInvalid} key issue(s).
dialog.diff.status.sourceTruncated: One or both tables were cut off before comparing; the diff may be missing rows beyond that point.
diff.reason.blankKey: This row's key is blank, so it cannot be matched to a row on the other side.
diff.reason.duplicateKey: This key appears more than once in its table, so it cannot be uniquely matched to a row on the other side.
diff.error.noKeyColumns: Pick at least one key column.
diff.error.tooManyKeyColumns: At most {max} key columns are allowed.
diff.error.unknownCompareColumn: Column to compare "{name}" was not found.

dialog.recentFiles.message: Pick a file to open again. The browser may ask for permission to read it.
dialog.recentFiles.note: This list is kept only in this browser. File contents are not stored.
dialog.recentFiles.noteSession: Because this page was opened from a file on your device, the list is kept only until the page is closed. File contents are not stored.
notify.recentEmpty: No recently opened files yet. Files you open with File > Open… appear here.
notify.recentPermissionDenied: Could not open “{name}”: the browser did not allow reading it.
notify.recentMissing: Could not open “{name}”: it may have been moved or deleted. It was removed from the list.
columnMenu.label: Column {letter}: {header}
columnMenu.sortedNote: Rows are ordered by this column. Press the highlighted button again for the original order. Cells in the range can't be edited while ordered.
columnMenu.conditionsNote: This column also has conditions. Open Filter by Condition… to change them.
notify.headerFilterOn: Added filter buttons to the header row of {range}. Use them to order rows or choose which values to show. Ctrl+Z undoes this.
